name: Marcello Di Nucci
source:
Zodiac: Aries

Marcello is a stranger who bumps into MC while chasing after someone. 
He doesn't seem to be from around here... but, what's with the groups of suited men following him around? 

Likes: headstrong women, booze, long baths, fashion, working out and sweets. 
Dislikes: traitors, guns to his face (though he gets that a lot), men who abuse or disrespect women, tea

Fun Fact: He splurges on expensive shampoo.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/love-spell-written-in-the-stars]official website[/url]]
